_comment: R6's native-play lift (tools/r6_native_lift.sh, docs/NATIVE_R6.md section 4): the same API boundaries as the development lift (config/dev_capture_observers.json) -- the libgcm entry points, asp's methods, the game's draws, the flip and memcpy -- without the development lift's store probes (no PPU_OBS_ST on every store of an observed body; R4's verify mode needs the development lift). Addresses only: the lifted bodies run unchanged unless the recorder replaces them.

the game's memcpy: R3's recorder takes copies into RSX local memory (the fragment programs' uploads) into its program shadow, and asp's re-emissions of its state store into the command buffer
asp's colour write mask setter (device, const u8 rgba[4]): the colour mask PPFX's draws inherit
asp's sampler bind (device, unit, enable): a unit's sampler state from asp's per-unit sampler table; PPFX inherits unit 0's address mode from it
asp's append of a prebuilt block (context, source, words): the copy of its state store, by the game's memcpy
asp's pass apply: colour mask, depth test and depth mask for a pass
asp's state block compiler (context, ...): asp's whole render state into a block
asp's rebuild of its global state block (through 0x006CD014)
asp's depth write mask setter (device, enable)
asp's polygon offset setter (device, factor, units)
asp's depth test and function setter (device, func)
asp's cull setter (device, mode)
asp's blend setter (device, ...)
asp's stencil function and operations setter
asp's stencil write mask setter
asp's line width setter
asp's draw (the draw context's method): R5's asp records, built at its return (docs/NATIVE_R4.md section 10)
asp's texture apply (this, {unit, ..}, CellGcmTexture*): a unit's texture
asp's vertex stream bind (stream object, {index, ..}): a vertex input's size, type, stride, location, frequency, offset
asp's vertex stream rebind (stream object holding its index)
asp's vertex constant upload (this, {start, ..}, const float*, count)
asp's vertex program upload and bind (shader object): R5's probe of asp's shader container
asp's fragment program bind (shader object): R5's probe
asp's blend enable setter (method 0x0310): R5's encoders and setter probe (docs/NATIVE_R5.md)

asp's alpha function setter (enable, function, reference: 0x0304-0x030C)
asp's stencil test enable setter (0x0328)
asp's render target set (the surface: 0x018C-0x02B8, 0x1D88)
asp's fragment program upload (an inline transfer into local memory)
asp's fragment program constant patch (an inline transfer into a program in local memory)
asp's texture apply for unit 4 (0x1A80-0x1A98, control 3 0x1850): the shadow map
cellGcmSetDrawIndexArray (the game's own draws, not PPFX's): R5 records those inside asp's scene -- the reflection's stencil mask, the water, scene parts (docs/NATIVE_R5.md)
